words.definition: a flat open area of ground, as in Vietnamese compounds

words.definition: to be more important than something else and beat it

examples.sentence: In this game, a king trumps a queen.

words.definition: the side sheltered from wind; also a common family name

examples.sentence: Mr Lee has worked as an engineer for twenty years.

words.definition: to keep troubling or attacking someone again and again

words.definition: a bad habit or immoral behaviour
